description: "Overnight in London, another wall chills with the same snowman—Mr Snowmann's mark, simple and everywhere, melting into city legend." - Elena Petrov
process_note: The night Mr. Snowmann was born on a London wall at 3 AM, simple and defiant. Repetition as branding, simplicity as rebellion—I wanted something that would melt into the city's memory. By morning, he was everywhere, watching commuters who'd never notice they were being documented.

process_note: Torsos & Faces—the first time I let bodies fragment without apology. Flesh becomes landscape, identity becomes optional. I was exhausted from making faces recognizable, so I deconstructed them into pure form and shadow. The viewer projects their own narrative.
